description.mn: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Chinotto Di Liguria: Хүйс харгалзахгүй шипр үнэр (EDT). Эхний ноот: мандарин, чинотто; зүрхний ноот: жасмин, герань, кардамон, розмарин; суурь ноот: пачули, заар.
description.en: Chinotto di Liguria by Acqua di Parma is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women and men. Chinotto di Liguria was launched in 2018. Top notes are mandarin orange and chinotto; middle notes are jasmine, geranium, cardamom and rosemary; base notes are patchouli and musk.
